# Truth Social

3 endpoints, all GET. Base URL `https://www.socialcrawl.dev`, auth header `x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY`.

**Credit costs:** 3 standard (1 credit) - the exact cost is in each endpoint heading below.

<!-- BEGIN:GENERATED:TOC (auto-generated by generate-docs.ts - SK-02) -->

| Endpoint | Cost | Returns | Use when |
|----------|------|---------|----------|
| [GET /v1/truthsocial/post](#get-v1truthsocialpost---1-credit-standard) | 1 credit (standard) | Returns one Truth Social post's text, like, retruth and reply counts, media attachments… | Use it when you have a post URL and want that single truth rather than the whole feed. |
| [GET /v1/truthsocial/profile](#get-v1truthsocialprofile---1-credit-standard) | 1 credit (standard) | Returns a Truth Social account's public profile: display name, bio, follower and… | Use it when you have a handle and want the account snapshot before pulling its posts. |
| [GET /v1/truthsocial/user/posts](#get-v1truthsocialuserposts---1-credit-standard) | 1 credit (standard) | Returns a Truth Social user's recent truths, each with its text, like, retruth and reply… | Use it for an account's feed, passing either handle or user_id, and paging deeper with… |

**Cheaper or broader options:** `prism/creator-card` - The same creator's profiles on several platforms in one call. `prism/profiles` - Up to 50 profiles per call, at the same price per profile, with the ones not found refunded.

## GET /v1/truthsocial/post - 1 credit (standard)

Returns detailed information about a specific Truth Social post including the text content, like count, retruth count, reply count, media attachments, author info, and creation timestamp.

**Use when** you have a post URL and want that single truth rather than the whole feed.
**Cost** cache 600 s
**Paging** none

**Query params**

- `url` (required) - Full URL of the Truth Social post · e.g. `https://truthsocial.com/@realDonaldTrump/posts/123456789`

**Response** `Post` object at `data`, `{ computed, post }` ([full schema](schemas/Post.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `post.author.username` | Author username |
| `post.content.text` | Post caption, description, or text content |
| `post.id` | Platform-specific post ID… |
| `post.published_at` | Post creation timestamp as an ISO 8601 UTC string. |
| `computed.content_category` | Keyword-classified content category… |
| `computed.engagement_rate` | Computed engagement rate (0..1). |

+14 more fields in the full schema.

**Next** `truthsocial/user/posts` (`handle` ← `data.post.author.username`) - List Truth Social user posts. · `truthsocial/profile` (`handle` ← `data.post.author.username`) - Get Truth Social user profile.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/truthsocial/post" \
  --data-urlencode "url=https://truthsocial.com/@realDonaldTrump/posts/123456789" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/truthsocial/profile - 1 credit (standard)

Returns public profile information for a Truth Social user including display name, follower count, following count, truth count, bio, and profile image URL.

**Use when** you have a handle and want the account snapshot before pulling its posts.
**Cost** cache 900 s
**Paging** none

**Query params**

- `handle` (required) - Truth Social username without the @ symbol · e.g. `realDonaldTrump`

**Response** `Author` object at `data`, `{ author, computed }` ([full schema](schemas/Author.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `author.id` | Platform-specific user ID… |
| `author.url` | Direct URL to the profile page |
| `author.username` | User handle or username |
| `author.avatar_url` | URL to profile picture |
| `author.bio` | Profile biography or description |
| `author.display_name` | Display name or full name |

+11 more fields in the full schema.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/truthsocial/profile" \
  --data-urlencode "handle=realDonaldTrump" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/truthsocial/user/posts - 1 credit (standard)

Returns a list of recent truths posted by a Truth Social user. Each truth includes the text content, like count, retruth count, reply count, media attachments, and creation timestamp.

**Use when** you want it for an account's feed, passing either handle or user_id, and paging deeper with next_max_id.
**Cost** cache 600 s
**Paging** cursor (native `next_max_id`) · ≈20/page (observed) · depth unknown · N items ≈ ceil(N/20) x 1 credits

**Query params**

- `handle` (optional, string) - Truth Social username without the @ symbol · e.g. `realDonaldTrump`
- `user_id` (optional, string) - Truth Social user id. Use this for faster response times. Trumps is 107780257626128497. It is the 'id' field in the profile endpoint.
- `next_max_id` (optional, string) - Used to paginate to next page
- `trim` (optional, boolean) - Set to true for a trimmed down version of the response

**Constraints**

- Provide at least one of `handle`, `user_id`.

**Response** `PostList` rows at `data.items[]`, each `{ computed, post }` ([full schema](schemas/PostList.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `post.author.username` | Author username |
| `post.content.text` | Post caption, description, or text content |
| `post.id` | Platform-specific post ID… |
| `post.published_at` | Post creation timestamp as an ISO 8601 UTC string. |
| `post.url` | Direct URL to the post on the source platform |
| `computed.content_category` | Keyword-classified content category… |

+13 more fields in the full schema. Never filled: `post.engagement.saves`, `post.engagement.views`. Page-level: `data.dropped`.

**Next** `truthsocial/profile` (`handle` ← `data.items[].post.author.username`) - Get Truth Social user profile.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/truthsocial/user/posts" \
  --data-urlencode "handle=realDonaldTrump" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```
